publishedRecipe.name: Puttanesca Pasta Salad with Tuna, Anchovies & Artichokes

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic and shallots; place both in a large bowl.
Finely mince anchovy fillets; add to the bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop capers and add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Drain pasta in a colander and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, flake with a fork, and add to the bowl. Gently toss the salad to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls or plates. Garnish with pine nuts and enjoy!
